name: Mailchimp
prompt: Build a newsletter tool with: subscriber list management (add/remove/import CSV), WYSIWYG email editor, send via Resend or Postmark API, open/click tracking with pixel and redirect links, unsubscribe page, and a simple dashboard showing subscriber count and recent campaign stats. SQLite backend.
notes: Newsletter sending is one of the most vibecodable SaaS categories. Deliverability is the real challenge, not the code.
